resources.string: Online, audio goes through Bun Do to Microsoft Azure for transcription. Offline, an installed Parakeet model works on this device. Review the saved text, especially quantities and dates. AI cleanup is a separate action.
Sign in again to transcribe online. Your recording is saved. You can also use local speech, export it or delete it.
Online transcription did not finish. Your recording is saved. Retry may send it to Azure again. You can also export it or delete it.
No connection and no local speech model. Your recording is saved. Connect and retry, download Parakeet, or export the recording.
